resources.string: EOX Sentinel-2 imagery (2016), with lower detail. Internet connection required.
Offline mode uses the downloaded street map. Satellite imagery returns when online.
EOxCloudless by EOX IT Services GmbH\nContains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2016
Satellite imagery: EOxCloudless by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2016), CC BY 4.0. https://cloudless.eox.at

OpenFreeMap supplies street maps; EOX supplies optional Sentinel-2 satellite imagery. Neither requires an API key or account. The selected tile provider receives your IP address and requested map areas.
Night map design adapted from OpenFreeMap / OpenMapTiles Dark Matter and CartoDB Basemaps by Stamen and Paul Norman (CC BY 3.0 / 4.0).
Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Online tiles: OpenFreeMap, OpenMapTiles schema (CC BY 4.0). Offline extract: Geofabrik, 2026-10-25. Renderer: MapLibre Native (BSD 2-Clause).
